mission: Arbitrary public unmodified HF dense 405B; executor only; batch 1; one GPU peak <=8 GiB; original output, RNG and successor state; same-machine native 4B Q4 warm p50 <=1.2x, p95 <=1.5x; existing TTFT requirement unchanged.
final_theorem: Construct a finite uniform executor and state relation for every admitted checkpoint, legal prompt/context and RNG state, preserving the frozen original ABI and proving complete initialization, memory and latency upper bounds relative to the same frozen baseline population.
mission_abi_baseline_workload: NOT YET FROZEN; no full mission or quantile acceptance possible in this study
primitive_abi: IEEE binary32 fmaf, round-to-nearest-ties-even, gradual underflow, exact input bit patterns, specified serial reduction order. Not claimed equivalent to arbitrary torch/cuBLAS/TensorCore reduction.

principles.name: guarded native rounding-phase composition
principles.reversal: compose exact state transitions instead of reassociating numerical sums
principles.route: A reusable length-k summary evaluates with constant integer work; >=10x only after fully charging summary construction, guards and reuse
principles.risk: product-dependent constructor reads all terms; binade crossings invalidate an unguarded summary

principles.name: causal suffix synchronization
principles.reversal: evaluate a short suffix over a certified incoming interval and erase an uncomputed prefix only when native endpoints coalesce
principles.route: geometric suffix evaluator uses <4k endpoint FMAs on a success at k and k distinct weights; need k far below n/40 plus all metadata and movement costs
principles.risk: signed ordinary reductions preserve a wide incoming interval; all late native work and repeated operand loads count

principles.name: backward native rounding-preimage program
principles.reversal: pull an exact output-word interval backward through native FMA, rather than enumerate all 2^32 accumulator states
principles.route: a bounded monotone inverse constructs a reusable exact incoming-state certificate; long prefix can be omitted only when its paid bound lies inside it
principles.risk: up to 64 native calls per inverse stage and query-dependent products; no free reuse or future target output

relationship_to_previous_failures: Not a reopening of local zero-product absorption or exact result reassociation. A retains ordered rounding, B/C exploit whole-suffix state forgetting. No target-wide information reduction is assumed. Existing global-decoder and state-quotient alternatives remain unpromoted.
primary_obligations: O2: explicit causal native reduction program
O3: exact native word result and state-substitution induction

datasets.random_distribution: independent signs, significand integers 128..255, exponents -4..4, exact BF16-representable operands; synthetic not checkpoint traces
datasets.positive_control: 1024 terms; 1022 unit products followed by +2^80 and -2^80

acceptance.correctness: zero bit mismatches on declared controls; mathematical proof separately required for admitted domains
acceptance.core_gate: At least 10x fully charged operation AND movement route, original native/state lift, and target-scale sufficient upper bounds; positive controls alone cannot pass
acceptance.theory: VERIFIED_IN_MODEL only if full O1-O6 closed; a scoped native theorem is not full theory acceptance
